title: Card Shark
description: Deal hands of 3D cards onto the canvas. A standard 52-card deck with optional jokers is built in, and more decks are built from folders of card images (one named "Back"), and a GM control panel, opened from the Card Stacks sidebar, picks the deck, shuffles, deals and places each player's hand around the table. Right-click a card to flip it; hold Ctrl to peek at a facedown card you own.
